The black line plateaus at approximately 85%, not 85–88%, as shown in the figure.
The gray line reaches values closer to 80–85%, not 75–80%, between 25 and 35 years, as shown in the figure.

The description omits mentioning that the gray line (in Deutschland geboren) closely follows the trend of the black line (ohne Migrationshintergrund) with minor fluctuations, as highlighted in the reference.
